text: それ　いじょう　もちきれない　ですよ！

structure.jp: もちきれない　ですよ！

patterns.name: 〜きれない
patterns.explanation: きれない added to a verb says you can't do all of it because there is too much. もちきれない = 'can't carry it all'.

patterns.name: 〜以上
patterns.explanation: いじょう after a word means 'more than that'; with a 'not' verb it reads 'any more than'. それ いじょう = 'any more than that'.
